name: output
description: Write the body to PATH. A PATH that ends in / or names a folder gets the remote file name inside it; ghola creates that last folder when it does not exist, and a missing folder above it needs --output-create-dirs. With several URLs: one -o DIR/ serves all, or one -o for each URL in order.

name: output-name
description: Take the remote file name from the URL or from Content-Disposition. A name with a folder part is refused.

name: output-overwrite
description: Replace an existing file. Without it an existing file stops the job with exit 23.

name: output-create-dirs
description: Create the missing folders of PATH.

name: output-remote-time
description: Set the file time to the Last-Modified time.

name: output-select
description: Write only the value at the path of a JSON body (gjson syntax).

name: output-template
description: After each transfer write the template. It uses curl's %{name} variables and %{json}.

name: output-events
description: Write one JSON line to stderr for each transfer event: start, retry, done and error. docs/cli/output-events.schema.json defines the lines.

name: show-headers
description: Write the response header block to stdout before the body.

name: save-headers
description: Write the response header block to PATH.

name: quiet
description: Write no progress meter and no notes. Errors still go to stderr.

name: verbose
description: Write the request and response headers and the connection steps to stderr.

name: progress
description: Show the progress meter. Default: only when stderr is a terminal and the body does not go to it.

name: max-size
description: Stop with exit 63 when the body is larger than SIZE.

name: har
description: Write the request and the response to PATH as HAR 1.2.

name: trace
description: Write all bytes sent and received to PATH (- for stderr).

name: trace-format
description: The format of --trace.

name: trace-time
description: Add a time to each --trace and --verbose line.

name: method
description: Send the request with this method.

name: head
description: Send HEAD and write the response headers to stdout.

name: header
description: Add a request header. "Name:" removes a header that ghola or the profile sets.

name: user-agent
description: Set the User-Agent header.

name: referer
description: Set the Referer header. auto sends the previous URL after a redirect.

name: data
description: Send the body without changes. @file reads a file and @- reads stdin. The Content-Type is application/x-www-form-urlencoded unless -H sets one.

name: data-literal
description: Send the text as the body, also when it starts with @.

name: field
description: Add a URL-encoded form field to the body.

name: form
description: Send a multipart/form-data body.

name: json
description: Send a JSON body. Sets Content-Type and Accept to application/json.

name: query
description: Add a URL-encoded query parameter to each URL.

name: upload
description: Send the file as the body of a PUT.

name: range
description: Request only the byte range, for example 0-1023.

name: continue
description: Resume a partial file. The request sends If-Range, so a file that changed on the server starts again from byte 0.

name: continue-at
description: Resume at this byte offset.

name: chain
description: JSON-RPC shortcut: POST with the RPC headers of the chain.

name: url-glob
description: Expand {a,b} and [1-9] in URLs.

name: url-path-as-is
description: Send the path without removing ./ and ../.

name: request-target
description: Send this request target in place of the URL path.

name: variable
description: Set a variable: NAME=VALUE, NAME@FILE or %NAME (from the environment). Only the --expand-NAME form of an option expands {{name}} in its value, as in curl.

name: next
description: Start the options for the next URL.

name: input
description: Read URLs from PATH (- for stdin): one for each line, with options for each URL in aria2's format.

name: input-format
description: The format of --input.

name: http
description: The HTTP version. 2 uses HTTP/2 on https:// only: on http:// it sends HTTP/1.1, because ghola has no h2c upgrade (2-prior sends HTTP/2 at once). 3 and 3-only need --impersonate with a profile that has HTTP/3; 3-only fails when the answer is not HTTP/3. 1.0 is refused: ghola's HTTP clients write only HTTP/1.1 request lines.

name: compressed
description: Ask for gzip, deflate, br and zstd and decode the body. A segment of a download asks for identity.

name: follow
description: Follow redirects.

name: follow-max
description: Stop with exit 47 after this many redirects.

name: follow-trusted
description: Send -u and the Authorization and Cookie headers to other hosts after a redirect too.

name: fail
description: Exit 22 on status 400 and above. stdout keeps the body. -o writes no file.

name: hsts
description: Read and write the HSTS cache at PATH.

name: alt-svc
description: Read and write the Alt-Svc cache at PATH, in curl's format. An h3 entry turns on HTTP/3 for that origin only with --impersonate and a profile that has HTTP/3.

name: cond-time
description: Send If-Modified-Since (or If-Unmodified-Since with -) for the date or the file time.

name: cond-etag-save
description: Write the ETag of the response to PATH.

name: cond-etag-compare
description: Send If-None-Match with the ETag in PATH.

name: max-header-size
description: The largest response header block that ghola accepts.

name: timeout
description: Stop with exit 28 when one transfer takes longer.

name: timeout-connect
description: Stop with exit 28 when DNS + TCP + proxy + TLS take longer.

name: stall-time
description: Stop with exit 28 when the speed is below --stall-rate for this long.

name: stall-rate
description: The speed limit for --stall-time.

name: rate-max
description: Limit the speed of each transfer.

name: rate-max-total
description: Limit the speed of all transfers together.

name: wait
description: Wait between requests.

name: wait-jitter
description: Add a random wait from 0 to this duration before each request.

name: retry-max
description: Retries after a transient failure. A POST retries only when this is set.

name: retry-delay
description: The first wait before a retry. Retry-After from the server wins.

name: retry-max-time
description: Stop retries after this total time.

name: retry-status
description: The status codes that are retried. A refused or reset connection is retried. -t is one limit over all attempts, so a timeout is not retried.

name: ip
description: The IP version.

name: resolve
description: Use this address for host:port.

name: connect-to
description: Connect to host2:port2 for requests to host:port.

name: interface
description: Send from this interface or address.

name: local-port
description: Send from a local port in this range.

name: unix-socket
description: Connect through this Unix socket.

name: doh
description: Resolve names with DNS over HTTPS at this URL.

name: tls-verify
description: Check the server certificate. -k is --no-tls-verify.

name: tls-ca
description: Trust the CA certificates in PATH.

name: tls-ca-dir
description: Trust the CA certificates in this folder.

name: tls-cert
description: Send this client certificate.

name: tls-key
description: The private key of --tls-cert.

name: tls-cert-type
description: The format of --tls-cert.

name: tls-min
description: The lowest TLS version.

name: tls-max
description: The highest TLS version.

name: tls-ciphers
description: The TLS 1.2 cipher suites (Go picks the TLS 1.3 suites itself). Refused with --impersonate (exit 2): the profile sets the suites.

name: tls-pin
description: Refuse a server key that does not match.

name: tls-crl
description: Refuse certificates in this CRL.

name: tls-ocsp
description: Require a good OCSP staple.

name: tls-ech
description: Use Encrypted Client Hello when the server offers it.

name: user
description: Send these credentials. They go only to the host of the first URL unless --follow-trusted.

name: auth
description: The authentication method for --user.

name: auth-bearer
description: Send Authorization: Bearer with the token. It goes only to the host of the first URL unless --follow-trusted.

name: auth-aws-sigv4
description: Sign the request with AWS Signature Version 4. The key signs only requests to the host of the first URL unless --follow-trusted.

name: auth-netrc
description: Read credentials from ~/.netrc.

name: auth-netrc-file
description: Read credentials from this netrc file.

name: proxy
description: Send through this proxy: http https socks4 socks4a socks5 socks5h (SOCKS in phase 2).

name: proxy-user
description: The proxy credentials.

name: proxy-file
description: Read proxy URLs from PATH (one for each line).

name: proxy-strategy
description: How --proxy-file picks a proxy for each request.

name: proxy-check
description: Check each proxy before use and drop dead ones.

name: proxy-bypass
description: Hosts that go direct.

name: proxy-tls-*
description: Each --tls-* option has a --proxy-tls-* form for an HTTPS proxy.

name: cookie
description: Send this cookie, or the cookies in the file.

name: cookie-jar
description: Read cookies from PATH and write them back. ghola reads the Netscape format and the v0 JSON jar. A new jar is Netscape.

name: impersonate
description: Copy a browser's TLS and HTTP/2 fingerprint: chrome firefox safari edge. ghola profiles lists them. --tls-ca, --tls-ca-dir, --tls-cert, --tls-key, --tls-pin and --tls-crl work with it; the other --tls-* options are refused with exit 2, because they would change the fingerprint.

name: impersonate-headers
description: Send the browser's default headers in its order. --impersonate turns it on; --no-impersonate-headers turns it off.

name: impersonate-accept-language
description: Override the profile's Accept-Language.

name: connections
description: Split one file into N ranges on N connections. Needs Range support.

name: jobs
description: Run up to N transfers at the same time.

name: source
description: Another mirror of the same file. Segments go to the faster mirrors.

name: file-allocation
description: How the file space is reserved before the download.

name: checksum
description: Check the file against this digest before the job is done. Content-Digest and Metalink digests are checked by default.

name: session
description: Keep a state file next to each partial download, so ghola jobs resume can restart it.

name: on-complete
description: Run this command when a job finishes.

name: on-error
description: Run this command when a job fails.

name: background
description: Run in the background and write messages to --log.

name: log
description: Write messages to PATH.

name: depth
description: Follow links this many levels deep (0 = no limit).

name: parent
description: Follow links above the start folder.

name: hosts
description: The hosts that links may go to.

name: accept
description: Keep only file names that match.

name: reject
description: Skip file names that match.

name: accept-regex
description: Keep only URLs that match.

name: reject-regex
description: Skip URLs that match.

name: include-dirs
description: Follow only these folders.

name: exclude-dirs
description: Skip these folders.

name: layout
description: How the local folders copy the URL.

name: cut-dirs
description: Drop this many leading folders from the local path.

name: timestamps
description: Get a file again only when the server copy is newer.

name: requisites
description: Also get the images and styles that a page needs.

name: convert-links
description: Change links to work offline.

name: backup-converted
description: Keep the original of each converted file.

name: adjust-extension
description: Add .html or .css when the type needs it.

name: offline
description: Make the copy work offline: --requisites, --convert-links and --adjust-extension together.

name: robots
description: Obey robots.txt and nofollow.

name: quota
description: Stop after this many bytes in total.

name: spider
description: Check the links and save nothing.

name: file-names
description: Which characters a local file name may hold.

name: warc
description: Also write the exchange as a WARC file. A fetch needs -o FILE: the WARC records come from a transfer to a file.

name: config
description: Read options from PATH.

name: no-config
description: Read no config file.

name: help
description: Show help, or the help for a topic.

name: version
description: Show the version.
